# Fixtures for rd_lamps_ab and rd_lamps_gl (port/render/test/rd_lamps_ab.cmake:
# the lamps' pass area on WORK2, WORK2_PAD's band left lazy, WORK0's alpha
# sprite owed and the passes of two blur pairs against all off, byte for
# byte): fixture names of this repository (port/render/test/fixtures/
# NAME.rdfix), a name a line, replayed with the visibility test at its
# default.  The words seq=whole, seq=lamps and seq=dark name the three frames
# of one scene and size the two sequences are made of.  What each fixture
# shows (the glow's plan, the area, the band, the owed sprite) is its declared
# glow_plan, lamps_area_passes, lamps_bands_lazy and lamps_owed
# (port/render/test/fixtures/fixtures.txt).
#
# LAMPS: the lamps' meshes generated on WORK2 (the placement rules): the
# title's castle (512x512 GS), the Pixel's opening (848x448 GS)
fx-lamps-title seq=lamps
fx-lamps-opening
# DARK: the title with the sun off the picture, the opening's dark room
fx-lamps-title-dark seq=dark
fx-opening-dark
# WHOLE: the sun's fans on the picture: the title, the opening's sun
fx-boot-0200 seq=whole
fx-opening-sun
